content.summary: Since 2023, there have been over 230 offerings below $15 million apiece on Nasdaq, compared with 33 on the New York Stock Exchange.

content.title: Cuprina Holdings obtains dealer license for IVF media production facility
content.summary: Cuprina Holdings (CUPR), on April 6, completed construction of, and obtained ISO 13485 certification and a dealer license for, an operational in-vitro fertilization media production facility in Singapore. The ISO 13485 certification, which validates that Cuprina’s quality management system at the facility meets internationally agreed standards for medical device manufacturing, was issued by United Kingdom Accreditation Service, a part of the International Accreditation Forum.
